# VynTech Solutions

> VynTech Solutions is a Canadian software development and digital agency headquartered in Mississauga, Ontario. It builds websites, mobile apps, custom software, e-commerce stores and AI integrations, and provides SEO, cloud, DevOps and ongoing support for businesses across Canada and the United States, from startups building an MVP to enterprises modernizing legacy systems.

Key facts:
- Head office: 55 Village Centre Pl #200, Mississauga, ON L4Z 1V9, Canada
- Contact: info@vyntechsolutions.ca | +1 (877) 879-6061
- 5+ years in business, 30+ engineers, 500+ websites delivered, 98% client satisfaction, 24/7 support
- Tech stack: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, Node.js, React Native, AWS and Azure
- E-commerce platforms: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and custom builds
- Typical timelines: most websites launch in 4–8 weeks; AI integration projects take 2–8 weeks
- Process: discovery and strategy, architecture and design, two-week agile sprints with demos, launch and ongoing support
- Every website is custom-built (no templates), with a dedicated project manager and regular progress updates
- Also offers tax and accounting services for Canadian businesses and individuals through a CPA-certified team

Frequently asked questions:

**What other services do you provide?**
Beyond web development, we offer mobile app development, UI/UX design, SEO, custom software, cloud solutions, and ongoing maintenance.

**Do you provide customized website design services?**
Yes, every website is built from scratch around your brand and goals — no generic templates.

**Are you an e-commerce website development company?**
Yes, we build e-commerce platforms on Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom stacks, from catalogs to payment integration.

**Do you offer small business website development?**
Absolutely. We build websites for businesses of every size, including budget-friendly options for small businesses.

**What makes you one of the best website development companies in Toronto?**
Transparent communication, strong technical expertise, and results — 500+ websites delivered with a 98% client satisfaction rate.

**Where can I learn more about your company and team?**
Visit our About Us page (https://vyntechsolutions.ca/about) to learn our mission, values, and story.

**Can I track the progress of my new website project?**
Yes, you'll get a dedicated project manager and regular updates throughout development.

**Which e-commerce technology platforms do you work with?**
We work with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, and custom-coded solutions.

**How do I find a professional web design company in Toronto?**
Look for a company with a proven track record, transparent pricing, and real client results — all of which are core to how we work.

**Can you handle a complex migration without disrupting our business?**
Yes, we plan and test carefully, scheduling deployment during low-traffic windows to keep your business running smoothly.

## Services
- [Web Development](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/web-development): Custom websites, online stores and web applications built to load fast, rank well and convert visitors into customers
- [Mobile App Development](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps, from concept and design through testing and app store submission
- [Custom Software Development](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/custom-software-development): Internal tools, admin panels, CRMs and business applications built around how a company actually operates
- [AI Integration Services](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/ai-integration-services): AI chatbots, LLM and RAG integration (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), intelligent document processing and predictive analytics connected to existing CRMs, ERPs and websites
- [E-commerce Solutions](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/ecommerce-solutions): Shopify, WooCommerce and custom e-commerce stores, including catalogs and payment integration
- [UI/UX Design](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/ui-ux-design): Wireframes, prototypes and full design systems for websites and apps
- [SEO & Digital Marketing](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/seo-digital-marketing): Local SEO for small businesses, enterprise SEO, technical SEO and content strategy for Toronto and Canadian businesses
- [Cloud Solutions](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/cloud-solutions): Cloud setup, migration and optimization on AWS and Azure
- [DevOps & CI/CD](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/devops-cicd): Automated deployment pipelines, Docker containers and infrastructure setup
- [Maintenance & Support](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/maintenance-support): Bug fixes, updates, security patches and ongoing support for websites and apps
- [Tax & Accounting Services](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services/tax-accounting): Corporate and personal tax filing, GST/HST, bookkeeping, incorporation, part-time CFO services, SR&ED and government grant claims
- [All Services](https://vyntechsolutions.ca/services): Overview of every service VynTech offers
